prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: hero photograph for a premium French physiotherapy and sports health website.
Create ONE ultra-photorealistic luxury editorial photograph with extraordinary natural detail, the visual finesse of an 8K magazine shoot, at the highest native resolution available.
Scene: an adult physiotherapist wearing a matte blue-grey medical tunic is guiding an adult patient's gentle shoulder mobility exercise. Both adults are entirely clothed. The patient wears an opaque ivory short-sleeved athletic T-shirt and dark blue trousers, seated upright. The practitioner's two hands gently support the patient's clothed upper arm and forearm as the arm is raised slightly forward. Hands and elbow have relaxed natural anatomy. Camera focuses on attentive movement, not faces; faces completely outside the crop.
Composition: 5:4 landscape, medium-close framing of the arm and practitioner hands, key gesture centered and fully visible with generous margins, reusable in an almost-square website hero. A simple, generic softly blurred treatment setting, pale oak and off-white wall, no identifying location.
Lighting: beautiful soft lateral daylight, soft balanced shadows, muted blue-grey and warm ivory palette. High dynamic range with controlled highlights, no overexposure.
Details: convincing hands with five fingers each, natural nails and tiny skin creases, realistic forearm hair, clearly resolved cotton weave and real fabric tension at the sleeve, authentic seams and subtle wear. Premium art direction and completely natural human proportions.
Camera: professional full-frame photo, 85mm lens, f/4, optically plausible depth of field. Sharp point of contact, gentle background blur, natural skin and fabric colors, extremely detailed without artificial sharpening or smoothing.
No text, labels, logos, watermarks, collage, CGI, glamour poses, bare torsos, exposed back, extra limbs, impossible joints, cartoon anatomy, fake skin or medical machinery. Fictional illustrative scene; do not imitate any real practitioner or actual practice premises.
nature: Illustration photoréaliste générée par IA. Ne représente ni les praticiens ni les locaux réels.
requested: Esthétique photoréaliste haut de gamme, détail visuel 8K ; résolution native du fichier à documenter sans agrandissement.
